verdict.rationale: Browserbase documents a web search API that finds relevant websites from a query and a fetch API that converts a single URL into HTML, JSON or markdown. Neither is a site-mapping or URL-discovery capability that lists all URLs on a site without crawling, and nothing in the evidence describes one. The axis applies because Browserbase ships web-data APIs, but there is no evidence it delivers this one.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instantly discover all URLs on a website without fully crawling it
